Class BillAdjustmentTriggerHandlerTest

@IsTest()
private class BillAdjustmentTriggerHandlerTest

Test class for BillAdjustmentTriggerHandler. Validates field replication from parent Adjustment__c to child BillAdjustment__c on insert, and DLRS rollup calculations on insert, update, and delete.

private static void
afterDeleteTest()
Verifies that deleting a BillAdjustment__c record triggers DLRS rollup to reset OrdersAdjustmentsSubtotal2__c to zero on the parent Bill__c.

Verifies that inserting a BillAdjustment__c record triggers DLRS rollup to update OrdersAdjustmentsSubtotal2__c on the parent Bill__c.
private static void
afterUpdateTest()
Verifies that updating a BillAdjustment__c record triggers DLRS rollup to recalculate OrdersAdjustmentsSubtotal2__c on the parent Bill__c.
private static void
beforeInsertTest()
Verifies that inserting a BillAdjustment__c record replicates field values (name, amounts, fees, tax, tip, type) from the parent Adjustment__c record.

setup()
Creates test Account, Bill__c, and Adjustment__c records shared across all test methods.
